global.name: Under Pressure
global.effect: A Pressure Gauge builds as you fight. Kills, headshots, multikills, skill kills, status-effect kills, fire kills, and kills by other players in your group all add to it. Higher pressure means stronger bonuses. By default the primary bonus is Status Effects. Some passive modifiers can swap that for Signature Weapon Damage or Hazard Protection. The gauge decays if you stay out of cover too long.

actives.name: Fiery Aura
actives.effect: Secondary attribute: Armor Regen. While active, Armor Regen and Damage Resistance go up, with extra protection while sprinting. Enemies are set on fire the first time they enter its range. At higher levels the defense is stronger, and burning unique enemies can also restore Bonus Armor.

actives.name: Vicarious Combustion
actives.effect: Secondary attribute: Headshot Damage. A headshot on an enemy that is already burning also burns nearby enemies. Higher levels reach a larger area. At the highest level, headshots can apply Burn directly.

actives.name: Signed, Shield, Delivered
actives.effect: Secondary attribute: Skill Efficiency. Improves Signature Weapon performance, Shield Health, and Shield Active Regen. Kills with a Signature Weapon, or while using a shield, refill the magazine without using reserve ammo. At the highest level those kills can also extend the modifier.

activeNote: Active modifiers have no shared cooldown this season. Once you have enough Pressure you can trigger one. The gauge resets when it ends.

hostiles.name: Draining Presence
hostiles.effect: Drains ammunition from your magazine and reduces your Pressure while the affected enemy is close to you. Setting that enemy on fire is the only way to permanently remove or reverse it.

hostiles.name: Achilles' Heal
hostiles.effect: Restores health to the affected enemy and nearby allies when you break their weak points or armor pieces, and it also reduces your Pressure. Fire is the permanent counter.

hostiles.name: Thousand Cuts
hostiles.effect: Reduces your Pressure whenever the affected enemy hits you and applies a stacking damage-reduction debuff. Fire is the permanent counter.

passives.name: Flow Regulator
passives.effect: Earn +10% Pressure Gauge per action.

passives.name: Throttle Valve
passives.effect: Earn +25% Pressure Gauge per action, but the gauge decays 50% faster.

passives.name: Flux Stabilizer
passives.effect: Pressure Gauge decay is 25% slower.

passives.name: Pressure Control
passives.effect: Decay is 50% slower, but gain is reduced by 20% per action.

passives.name: Quality Seals
passives.effect: Decay begins after a longer period of time.

passives.name: Delayed Venting
passives.effect: Bonuses apply at 0%, 20%, 50%, and 80%. Active modifiers unlock at a 10% lower threshold.

passives.name: Leaky Valve
passives.effect: Cover no longer stops decay. Gains increase by 50%. Active modifiers need 95% Pressure. Decay pauses out of combat.

passives.name: Vacuum Seal
passives.effect: The gauge no longer decays, but gains are reduced by 50%.

passives.name: New Formula: Beta
passives.effect: Primary bonus becomes Signature Weapon Damage instead of Status Effects. Disabled if paired with New Formula: Gamma. PTS progression: 10%, 20%, 30%, 50%.

passives.name: New Formula: Gamma
passives.effect: Primary bonus becomes Hazard Protection instead of Status Effects. Disabled if paired with New Formula: Beta. PTS progression: 5%, 15%, 25%, 40%.

passives.name: Microwave Coils
passives.effect: Up to four pulsed enemies have a 30% chance to burn. Gain 3% bonus Pressure for every affected enemy.

passives.name: New Model
passives.effect: K8 Jetstream Flamethrower: +30% damage to named enemies, −15% total damage, −50% spread, +100% range, +25% equip speed. Specialization ammo pickups are doubled.

passives.name: Afterburner
passives.effect: After killing a burning enemy, +20% movement speed for 30 seconds.

passives.name: Flint and Steel
passives.effect: Shooting an enemy your skill is also damaging sets them on fire. PTS cooldown: 15 seconds.

passives.name: Fire with Fire
passives.effect: While in combat, being burned increases your burn damage by 50% for 30 seconds.

passives.name: Reserve Tank
passives.effect: After an Active Modifier, the gauge resets to 20% instead of 0%.

passives.name: All or Nothing
passives.effect: Bonuses below 80% become 0. Bonuses above 80% increase by 25% of their value. Disabled if paired with Kickstart.

passives.name: Kickstart
passives.effect: Bonuses above 80% become 0. Bonuses below 80% increase by 50% of their value. Disabled if paired with All or Nothing.

passives.name: Firestarter
passives.effect: Concussion grenades, flashbangs, and cluster grenades gain +100% range and apply a short burn.

passives.name: Modular Plates
passives.effect: Armor kits also grant +100% bonus armor and restore 100% of your shield. Insta armor kits grant +25% bonus armor and restore 50% of the shield.

sources.name: Ubisoft — The Division 2: Red Horizon
sources.covers: Global, active, and hostile descriptions (no exact hostile distances or percents).

sources.name: Ubisoft — Red Horizon PTS patch notes, 13 Aug 2026
sources.covers: Passive list and the numeric hostile values from the test server. Later notes lowered Draining Presence from 7m to 5m and Achilles' Heal pressure loss from 10% to 5%, so those PTS numbers are not repeated here as live facts.
